title: patient.pre_register input
description: Input for patient.pre_register: minimum administrative pre-registration for a new patient. Risk R3. No clinical history.

government_id.description: Government identifier, only when required by hospital policy. Sensitivity D3.

payer_id.description: Insurance or payer member identifier, only when required. Sensitivity D3.

privacy_notice_acknowledged.description: Must be true: the privacy notice was acknowledged.

confirmation_token.description: Token proving explicit user confirmation bound to this exact pre-registration action.

idempotency_key.description: Client-generated key that makes retries of the same request safe.

governance.validated_by: dr. Ferdi Andriska, S.H., M.Kn., CMDC
